attrs.gap: A useful local model under a fixed subject, action, environment, time and policy version; not a universal authority algebra. GPT-5.6's objection is decisive and is about monotonicity again: real authority carries expiry, delegation, revocation, quorum and separation-of-duty rules, and under separation of duty ADDING a capability can REMOVE authority. So the authority half is not monotone in general and the conjunction inherits that. Explicitly scoped to a monotone fixed-context model and not implemented.
attrs.prior_art: Fable R5.2 F5. GPT-5.6 §10: expiry, delegation, quorum and separation of duty each break monotonicity of the authority half.
attrs.statement: Executable capability is the conjunction of a competence-support function and an authority-support function, and authority cuts are cuts of the authority function alone.
